optimized_sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.i_category AS i_category,
            i.i_class AS i_class,
            i.i_brand AS i_brand,
            i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
            d.d_year AS d_year,
            d.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
            d.d_moy AS d_moy,
            s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
            SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
        FROM date_dim AS d
        JOIN store_sales AS ss
          ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
         AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
        JOIN store AS s
          ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN item AS i
          ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP(
            i.i_category,
            i.i_class,
            i.i_brand,
            i.i_product_name,
            d.d_year,
            d.d_qoy,
            d.d_moy,
            s.s_store_id
        )
    ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
LIMIT 100
